svg.text: Attendance Kiosk — WS2812B LED strip wiring
Raspberry Pi 3B · new LED path in colour, existing kiosk wiring in grey · nothing already on the board moves
Data on GPIO12 / physical pin 32 (hardware PWM0). Strip power is external — never from the header.
RS · E · D4 · D5 · D6 · D7 + 5 V + GND — unchanged
R/W tied to GND (write-only, so no 5 V reaches the Pi)
GPIO current draw: 24 mA of the 50 mA budget
SPI must stay disabled — LCD RS sits on GPIO10
quad buffer — 3.3 V → 5 V level shifter
HCT family is essential: TTL input thresholds
Tie off the three unused buffers — never leave CMOS inputs floating
pin 1 (1OE) → GND, or buffer 1 stays tri-stated
DOUT → DIN chains down the strip · 60 mA per LED at full white
separate from the Pi's own PSU
size for 60 mA × LED count, +30 % headroom
16 LEDs → 5 V 2 A · 30 LEDs → 5 V 3 A
2. Do NOT add dtoverlay=pwm — rpi_ws281x owns the PWM
3. Leave DMA at 10. dma=5 corrupts the SD card on a Pi 3
4. Grounds common first, PSU off. Data path last
5. Needs root — already covered by sudo -E python3
